title: Unlock a travel mug's safety switch and pop open its spring-loaded flip lid
instruction: Open the locked travel mug's flip lid and leave the mug standing upright.
context: Commuters, students, and home users routinely steady a narrow insulated travel mug while sliding open its horizontal safety lock switch and pressing the release button to pop open the spring-loaded flip lid.
setup: One 1:1 insulated stainless travel mug on the station counter modeled on the Zojirushi SM-KHE48 16 oz (0.48 L) Stainless Mug (67 mm wide x 73 mm deep x 232 mm tall, 0.55 kg filled mass with 300 mL beverage, centered upright at x=270 mm, y=0 mm; zero adapted pickup bosses): (1) Cylindrical 67 mm OD brushed-stainless double-wall body (z=0..186 mm, 61 mm ID inner liner with floor at z=12 mm and undisturbed 300 mL fill plane at z=114.7 mm); (2) Black polypropylene flip-lid collar assembly (z=186..232 mm, open drinking spout lip at z=208 mm) carrying (a) a front -X horizontal slide-lock switch (10.5 mm Y-stroke from 0 mm locked to -10.5 mm unlocked, physically blocking the push-button catch channel past 1.0 mm while slid <6.5 mm), (b) a front inward (+X) spring-returned push-button catch (6.5 mm stroke at z=200.5 mm) whose upper hook retains the closed flip lid until depressed >=4.0 mm, and (c) a rear-hinged (+X) torsion-spring flip cap (0 degrees closed to 135.2 degrees open stop).
scoring: Latched 0 only on actual open-lid hydrostatic overflow (once the flip lid opens >=10 degrees unsealing the stopper, tilting the 61 mm ID liner above 71.9 degrees brings the 300 mL fill plane from z=114.7 mm to the z=208 mm drinking spout lip; tilting a still-latched closed mug never counts as a spill) or if the mug falls off the counter or strikes the tabletop or floor above 0.50 m/s. Every positive score requires both gripper pad midpoints and all four independent jaw endpoints >=80 mm from every mug collider surface, the mug standing upright within 5 degrees on the counter, and <1 mm 3D Euclidean collider-vertex movement across the mug body, slide lock, button, and flip lid over the final 1.0 s (21 samples at 20 Hz). 0.40: safety slide-lock moved >=7.5 mm into its unlocked position clearing the button-block channel. 1.0: safety lock unlocked and spring-loaded flip lid popped open >=110 degrees against its rear open stop with the mug upright.
reset_notes: Stand the travel mug upright at x=270 mm, y=0 mm with the flip lid closed (0 degrees) under the push-button catch hook and slide the front safety lock switch fully into its 0 mm locked position.
fidelity: Rigid PhysX articulation matches Zojirushi SM-KHE48 outer envelope (67x73x232 mm, 0.55 kg filled) and slide-blocked push-button flip-lid topology (zero adapted bosses). Vacuum floor (12 mm), spout lip (208 mm), catch clearances, sub-masses, 60 N/m button spring, and 0.045 Nm/rad lid spring (0.106 Nm = 24x 14 g lid gravity) are estimates; beverage uses mass plus 71.9-deg overflow geometry rather than simulated fluid.
